key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
Oil prices exploded as suppression failed; Australian fuel prices set to rise 30c, hitting consumer sentiment
AUD smashed on growth scare; RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern
US core CPI pickup pushed Fed rate-hike odds to 90%, tightening global liquidity
Housing prices crashing with high-end hit hardest; first-home buyers surging
Mining cap raises accelerating (Canaccord-led), signalling sector stress
Gold underperforming ('gold schmould') despite geopolitical tensions

sectors.trend: Severely negative. Iron ore in active 'bloodletting' phase; oil surge benefits energy miners (Santos, Woodside) but commodity diversification hurts. Gold underperforming. Cap raises accelerating as juniors seek liquidity.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from iron ore weakness. Energy names (STO.AX, WDS.AX) relatively resilient. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) lagging. Small-caps (SUN.AX, MNR.AX, KUN.AX, GWA.AX) volatile.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and rate-hike fears compress equity valuations. RBA rental inflation concern signals prolonged tight policy. Superannuation reform debate adds policy uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face NIM pressure from rate volatility. Super fund flows (HUB.AX, PPA.AX) under political scrutiny. Credit risk rising with business confidence deteriorating.

sectors.trend: Positive short-term. Oil 'exploded' as suppression failed. Australia softening gas supply rules eases Asian fears. Santos preservation confirmed strategic priority.
sectors.implications: STO.AX, WDS.AX, AWE.AX benefit from oil/gas price spike. Fuel cost pass-through pressures downstream (WES.AX, CWP.AX).

sectors.trend: Negative. Woolworths breached 'Price Freeze' on staples; fuel +30c; business confidence deteriorating. Housing crash boosting first-home buyer activity but high-end softening.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, CWP.AX face margin squeeze from input costs. Housing-linked (MRG.AX, LPX.AX) mixed: volume up, price down.

sectors.trend: Mixed. AI cloud demand outpacing supply (Oracle, HIVE/BUZZ HPC). CSL.AX stable but Exelixis cancer delay signals pharma risk. ASX small-caps (NEU.AX, ION.AX) showing relative strength.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SVL.AX defensive. HIVE.AX, NEU.AX, ION.AX, ARL.AX in focus. AI infrastructure theme supportive.

sectors.trend: Negative. Housing price crash, high-end steepest falls. Rental inflation keeps RBA cautious. Migrant-driven supply push may ease long-term but near-term oversupply risk.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by yield curve. Residential builders (MRG.AX) benefit from first-home buyer surge.

key_themes: Global rate-hike cycle (Fed 90% odds) tightening liquidity, pressuring ASX
Commodity divergence: oil up, iron ore down, gold flat
AUD weakness amplifying import costs and fuel inflation
Housing market bifurcation: crash at top, resilience at affordable end
Superannuation policy debate creating political risk for financials
Mining sector liquidity stress via accelerating cap raises
AI/tech as relative safe haven within ASX

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration exposure; favour cash-flowing equities over growth; hedge AUD via short AUD/USD
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into energy (STO.AX, WDS.AX) and gold on dip
Avoid discretionary consumer; favour staples with pricing power (WES.AX, CWP.AX)
Monitor REIT valuations; favour residential builders over commercial; watch RBA rental data
Avoid small-cap miners pre-raise; wait for post-dilution entry; favour established producers
Diversify away from China-exposed commodity plays; monitor Chinese inflation data

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy producers on oil price spike
opportunities.rationale: Oil 'exploded' as suppression failed; gas supply rule easing supports LNG pricing; Santos preservation confirms strategic value

opportunities.recommendation: Selective gold miner accumulation on 'schmould' dip
opportunities.rationale: Gold underperforming despite geopolitical risk; buy-the-dip setup at support; hedge against AUD weakness
AI cloud demand outpacing supply; HIVE/BUZZ HPC scaling; ASX runners showing relative strength

opportunities.recommendation: Residential builders on first-home buyer surge
opportunities.rationale: Housing crash driving volume; affordable end resilient; policy support for first-home buyers

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore exposure; trim BHP/RIO/FMG
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; China inflation surge may signal demand slowdown; $90bn ASX sell-off led by miners

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness; increase cash allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'smashed' on growth scare; rate differential widening; import inflation risk rising
Canaccord-led mining cash dash signals distress; dilution risk elevated; wait for post-raise clarity

defensive_moves.recommendation: Defensive tilt to healthcare and staples
defensive_moves.rationale: CSL.AX, WES.AX, CWP.AX offer earnings visibility amid macro volatility; Woolworths pricing power intact despite 'Price Freeze' breach

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to extend $90bn weekly loss as Fed rate-hike expectations (90%) tighten global liquidity. Iron ore weakness and oil-driven fuel inflation create a stagflationary squeeze. AUD weakness amplifies import costs. RBA constrained by rental inflation, limiting rate-cut optionality. Expect ^AXJO to test lower supports.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction creating first-home buyer pipeline; AI/tech structural growth intact; energy transition (battery tech, gas) supportive. Superannuation reform debate may unlock policy tailwinds for financials. Iron ore likely to stabilise as China stimulus emerges. 6-12 month recovery contingent on global rate peak confirmation.
